title: refactor(Formalism/SharpRestriction/LevelLetterCocycles): drop hK from pchain_DN and remove pchain_DN'
body:
Remove the unnecessary `K ≤ X` hypothesis from `Formalism.MainNotions.N.Pv.LocalLengthBound.pchain_DN` in `PchainDNAlt.lean` by bounding the iterated quotient length via `Submodule.quotientQuotientEquivQuotientSup` and `Module.length_le_of_surjective`, delete the duplicated `pchain_DN'` in `LengthBoundOfHypotheses.lean`, and update its callers.

Changed declarations:
- Generalized `Formalism.MainNotions.N.Pv.LocalLengthBound.pchain_DN` in `PchainDNAlt.lean` by dropping the `hK` parameter.
- Removed `Formalism.MainNotions.N.Pv.LocalLengthBound.pchain_DN'` in `LengthBoundOfHypotheses.lean` and updated its call site to `pchain_DN`.
- Updated both calls to `pchain_DN` in `FrobeniusSqComparisonLetter.lean`.
